description: A person or virtual resource assigned to a TmWorkItem. The assignment keeps scheduling metadata while exposing conversion to the shared TmUserRef snapshot.

members.name: Color
members.description: Optional CSS color used to tint the person in timelines/avatars.

members.name: HourlyRate
members.description: Hourly billing rate for cost tracking. Null = not specified.

members.name: IsVirtual
members.description: When true, this is a generic placeholder resource (not a real user account).

members.name: SourceKey
members.description: Optional provider/source discriminator for applications with multiple people sources.

members.name: TenantId
members.description: Optional tenant, workspace, or application scope identifier.

members.name: ToUserRef
members.description: Creates a shared user reference from this assignment snapshot.

members.name: FromUserRef
members.description: Creates an assignment snapshot from a shared user reference.
